factsUsed: TACSTD2 is ENSG00000184292 on GRCh37 chromosome 1, positions 59041099-59043166, negative strand.
Canonical transcript ENST00000371225.2 has one exon and a 972-bp coding span at 59041857-59042828 encoding a 323-aa protein.
P09758 is the reviewed human Tumor-associated calcium signal transducer 2 entry.
The protein is 323 amino acids and has extracellular, transmembrane, and cytoplasmic topology.
The TCGA cancer RNA category is low cancer specificity and detected in many cancers.
Normal tissue protein context includes abundant cytoplasmic and membranous expression in respiratory and squamous epithelial cells.
The page describes medium consistency between antibody staining and RNA expression data.

sources.source: Human Protein Atlas breast cancer view
factsUsed: The displayed TCGA breast invasive carcinoma cohort has 1022 RNA samples and average TACSTD2 expression of 291.5 pTPM.
This mixed breast-cancer cohort is external context only and is not a TNBC-specific or cross-platform calibration set.

boundary: Public database context is interpretive only. It does not rescue failed sample QC and is not proof of Diana tumor-cell surface TROP-2 or treatment benefit.
